title_en: The Song of Grace (a plea for the Lord's favour)
translation:
Here begins the holy Pasavalo ||25||

1. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from self-interest -- turn it away from self-interest; Hari, Hari, grant us in great abundance the highest good that lies in your Name.

2. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from falsehood and crooked understanding -- turn it away from falsehood and crooked understanding; Hari, Hari, grant us right understanding, O Master of the three worlds.

3. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from "I" and from pride -- turn it away from "I" and from pride; Hari, Hari, you who are Niranjan, the stainless Master, come and dwell in our heart.

4. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from the taste of the senses -- turn it away from the taste of the senses; Hari, Hari, let me repeat your name unbroken, O Master.

5. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from fancies about others -- turn it away from fancies about others; Hari, Hari, give us instead, in great abundance, the thought of your Name.

6. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from another man's wife -- turn it away from another man's wife; Hari, Hari, let me delight in your Name before all else.

7. Turn our mind away, O Lord, from sleep, that enemy -- turn it away from sleep, that enemy; Hari, Hari, let it not break the repeating of your name.

8. Grant our mind, O Lord, bhakti (devotion) and loving feeling -- grant it bhakti and loving feeling; Hari, Hari, it is to you, Parbrahm, that I make my plea.

9. Grant our mind, O Lord, the company of the saints -- grant it the company of the saints; Hari, Hari, so that through you, Parbrahm, my vigat -- my whole reckoning, all that I have been -- may be wiped away.

10. Grant our mind, O Lord, detachment and faith -- grant it detachment and faith; Hari, Hari, fulfil the hope that is in my heart.

11. Thus prays the Vaishnav, the servant of Harji -- thus prays the Vaishnav, the servant of Harji: Hari, Hari, I ask only for a dwelling place at the feet of the saints.

Here the holy Pasavalo is complete ||25||
